script_text: B Taurus, Venus — your ruling planet — ignites your 10th House of Career with a tense square from Mars this week, and the universe demands bold action. Mid-week: Moon enters your 7th House of Partnerships Wednesday, where hidden desires surface and someone from your past reappears. Late week: Jupiter trine your 2nd House of Wealth Thursday opens unexpected financial doors, and weekend Neptune in your 12th House asks you to rest. Worst day: Monday — Mars square Venus creates friction in relationships and impulsive decisions that backfire. Hold your ground on financial commitments until Thursday when Jupiter's trine expands your resources. Follow for daily updates.
